source/obd/obd_pid.c: table of 19 Mode 01 PIDs (04-09 load, coolant, fuel trims both banks; 0B MAP, 0C RPM, 0D speed, 0E timing, 0F IAT, 10 MAF, 11 throttle, 1F run time, 2F fuel, 33 baro, 42 module V, 46 ambient, 5C oil) with SAE J1979 formulas, decoding to metric from raw bytes or an assembled reply (first ECU with a full answer), and ASCII display text in US (mph, F, inHg) or metric units; trim total and vacuum (baro - MAP) helpers. tests/test_pid.c covers formulas, short / refused / other-PID replies, multi-ECU CAN, formatting and -0 rounding. 139 tests pass with clang and gcc; devkitPro build clean.

source/obd/obd_live.c: one request per step, round-robin over the wanted PIDs the car supports and obd_pid decodes; latest value, time, smoothed refresh rate and read count per PID; ATRV every 5 s (stops asking if refused); a PID dropped after 3 NO DATA / unusable replies in a row; OBD_LIVE_LOST on timeout or I/O error so the caller reconnects; IDLE when nothing is left; manifold vacuum from PID 33 or a MAP read between two RPM-0 reads (an engine start isn't mistaken for baro); overall requests per second. 11 host tests on the fake adapter; emulator check polls every scenario. Running it on the worker thread comes with the LIVE / TRIM screens (3n6.5, 3n6.6).

Tests updated (left out, asked alone, dropped after 3 NO DATA alone, log cap). 171 tests pass with clang and gcc; emulator checks pass (car shows 3 left out: the emulator merges two ECUs' 0B replies); 3dsx builds.
